aha: Only columns over or beside a pit may fall (stones on the trench floor roll into a neighbouring pit, leaning tops topple in after their neighbour); free the pearl on the middle column and push it home first, and time a drop to crush the piranha.
deadlocks: Dropping the column next to the gate (no pit): its stones block the trench at the gate.
Pushing the first pearl before the second pearl has been pushed home: the two pearls jam in the trench.
Dropping the leftover stone of the left pair (x=3) after its pit is full: it lands in the trench right in front of the pearl.
